about: Townsfolk quirks (dungeon/world/townsfolk.py): text is a subject-less clause ('talks to pigeons'), bio the first-person line their dating profile shows (dungeon/world/dating.py). Add quirks freely.

quirks.text: remembers everyone's usual order
quirks.bio: I will remember your usual order after one visit.

quirks.text: hums under their breath
quirks.bio: I hum under my breath. Sorry in advance.

quirks.text: wears the same green scarf every day
quirks.bio: You will know me by the green scarf.

quirks.text: carries a battered notebook everywhere
quirks.bio: Never without my battered notebook.

quirks.text: can't resist a terrible pun
quirks.bio: Warning: I can't resist a terrible pun.

quirks.text: knows every dog in the neighborhood by name
quirks.bio: I know every dog in the neighborhood by name. The owners, less so.

quirks.text: is always running five minutes late
quirks.bio: I will be five minutes late. I'm working on it.

quirks.text: collects odd little trinkets
quirks.bio: I collect odd little trinkets. Ask me about the best one.

quirks.text: names every plant they own
quirks.bio: Every one of my plants has a name.

quirks.text: has an opinion about everyone's shoes
quirks.bio: I will have an opinion about your shoes.

quirks.text: talks to pigeons
quirks.bio: Yes, I talk to pigeons. They listen.

quirks.text: sketches people when they think no one is looking
quirks.bio: I sketch people when they aren't looking.

quirks.text: whistles the same tune all day
quirks.bio: I whistle the same tune all day and I don't know what it is.

quirks.text: keeps sweets in every pocket
quirks.bio: There are sweets in every one of my pockets.

quirks.text: reads the last page of a book first
quirks.bio: Confession: I read the last page of a book first.

quirks.text: counts the steps on every staircase
quirks.bio: Every staircase gets counted. Ask me how many.

quirks.text: always sits facing the door
quirks.bio: Always sitting facing the door. Old habit.

quirks.text: keeps a pencil tucked behind one ear
quirks.bio: There is a pencil behind my ear. Always.

quirks.text: greets every cat like an old friend
quirks.bio: Every cat I meet gets greeted like an old friend.

quirks.text: rates every meal out of ten
quirks.bio: Your cooking will get a score out of ten. Lovingly.

quirks.text: carries a pocketknife and a spare button
quirks.bio: Need a pocketknife or a spare button? Got both.

quirks.text: quotes old proverbs at the oddest moments
quirks.bio: Expect old proverbs at the oddest moments.

quirks.text: can name every bird by its song
quirks.bio: Hum a birdsong and I can name the bird.

quirks.text: taps out rhythms on any surface
quirks.bio: Tables, knees, steering wheels: I drum on all of them.

quirks.text: keeps a jar of buttons nobody may touch
quirks.bio: My button jar is strictly look, don't touch.

quirks.text: never leaves without checking the weather twice
quirks.bio: Checking the weather twice before leaving. Every time.

quirks.text: folds napkins into little animals
quirks.bio: Give me a napkin and you'll get a little swan back.

quirks.text: always knows where the best bread in town is
quirks.bio: Ask where the best bread in town is. I always know.

quirks.text: saves every ticket stub and receipt
quirks.bio: Every ticket stub and receipt I've ever had is in a box.

quirks.text: gives everyone a nickname within a week
quirks.bio: Within a week, you'll have a nickname. No refunds.

quirks.text: drinks tea far too hot for anyone else
quirks.bio: My tea is hotter than anyone else can stand.

quirks.text: has a lucky coin and flips it to decide things
quirks.bio: Big decisions are made by my lucky coin.

quirks.text: apologizes to furniture after bumping into it
quirks.bio: Sorry, table. Yes, I apologise to furniture.

quirks.text: keeps a pressed flower in their wallet
quirks.bio: A pressed flower lives in my wallet.

quirks.text: laughs a beat after everyone else
quirks.bio: My laugh arrives a beat after everyone else's.

quirks.text: rearranges the salt and pepper wherever they sit
quirks.bio: Salt and pepper will be rearranged wherever I sit.

quirks.text: knows a card trick and will show you
quirks.bio: Got a card trick, and you will be seeing it.

quirks.text: writes the date at the top of everything
quirks.bio: Everything I write gets the date at the top.

quirks.text: collects other people's lost gloves
quirks.bio: Lost a glove? Probably in my collection.

quirks.text: speaks to babies as if they were grown-ups
quirks.bio: Babies get full adult conversation from me.

quirks.text: keeps a running tally of every rainy day
quirks.bio: Keeping a running tally of rainy days. Ask for the count.

quirks.text: carries a spare umbrella to lend out
quirks.bio: Spare umbrella always on hand, ready to lend.

quirks.text: always orders the second-cheapest thing
quirks.bio: Second-cheapest thing on the menu, every time.

quirks.text: never sits in the same seat twice
quirks.bio: Never the same seat twice. Keeps life interesting.

quirks.text: keeps lists of favorite words
quirks.bio: Keeper of lists of favourite words. Tell me yours.

quirks.text: tears bread into perfect little squares
quirks.bio: Bread gets torn into perfect little squares. Don't ask.

quirks.text: wears mismatched socks on purpose
quirks.bio: Mismatched socks, on purpose, always.

quirks.text: can fall asleep sitting up anywhere
quirks.bio: Can nap sitting up anywhere. It's a gift.

quirks.text: knows when every bell in town will ring
quirks.bio: Ask me when the next church bell rings.

quirks.text: keeps a small brass bell on their keys
quirks.bio: You will hear my keys before you see me. Brass bell.

quirks.text: salutes every magpie
quirks.bio: Every magpie gets a salute. Just to be safe.

quirks.text: always has a piece of string handy
quirks.bio: Need string? Always have some.

quirks.text: rates strangers' dogs out loud
quirks.bio: Your dog will be rated out loud. It will score well.

quirks.text: keeps a seed packet in every coat
quirks.bio: Every coat I own has a seed packet in the pocket.

quirks.text: memorizes the names on every shop sign without meaning to
quirks.bio: Accidentally memorised every shop sign in town.

quirks.text: says goodnight to the moon
quirks.bio: Saying goodnight to the moon is part of my routine.

quirks.text: can recite every street in the neighborhood in order
quirks.bio: Can recite every street in the neighbourhood, in order.

quirks.text: always pays in exact change
quirks.bio: Exact change, always. Down to the penny.

quirks.text: keeps a tiny sewing kit and fixes other people's hems
quirks.bio: Your hem is coming down. Hold still, I have a kit.

quirks.text: eats dessert first whenever allowed
quirks.bio: Dessert first whenever allowed. Life is short.

quirks.text: sniffs every book before opening it
quirks.bio: Every book gets a sniff before I open it.

quirks.text: taps the doorframe twice on the way out
quirks.bio: Two taps on the doorframe on the way out. Every door.

quirks.text: collects smooth stones from every trip
quirks.bio: Smooth stones from every trip fill my shelves.

quirks.text: draws little suns on the corners of notes
quirks.bio: My notes come with little suns in the corners.

quirks.text: can tie a dozen kinds of knots
quirks.bio: Can tie a dozen kinds of knots. Useful at parties.

quirks.text: keeps a diary of the weather and nothing else
quirks.bio: My diary is about the weather and nothing else.

quirks.text: carries a magnifying glass for no clear reason
quirks.bio: There's a magnifying glass in my bag. No idea why.

quirks.text: knows the birthday of every neighbor's cat
quirks.bio: Every cat on my street has a birthday I remember.

quirks.text: always walks on the sunny side of the street
quirks.bio: Sunny side of the street, always.

quirks.text: cuts sandwiches into triangles and nothing else
quirks.bio: Sandwiches are triangles. This is not up for debate.

quirks.text: saves the puzzle page for later and never finishes it
quirks.bio: Saving the puzzle page for later. Later never comes.

quirks.text: finishes every sentence with a little nod
quirks.bio: Every sentence I say ends with a little nod.

quirks.text: keeps a stash of postcards and sends them to friends across town
quirks.bio: Expect postcards from me, even from across town.

quirks.text: names the pigeons on their windowsill
quirks.bio: The pigeons on my windowsill all have names.

quirks.text: laughs loudest at their own jokes
quirks.bio: Nobody laughs louder at my jokes than me.

quirks.text: keeps an old watch that runs ten minutes fast on purpose
quirks.bio: My watch runs ten minutes fast, on purpose.

quirks.text: can't pass a puddle without hopping over it
quirks.bio: No puddle goes unhopped on my watch.

quirks.text: makes up words and uses them seriously
quirks.bio: Fluent in words I made up. Very seriously.

quirks.text: keeps a jar of honey from every market they visit
quirks.bio: A jar of honey from every market I visit. The cupboard is full.

quirks.text: hums a different tune for every season
quirks.bio: A different tune for every season. Autumn's is the best.

quirks.text: tucks a flower in their buttonhole on Fridays
quirks.bio: Fridays mean a flower in my buttonhole.

quirks.text: tests every chair before sitting down
quirks.bio: Every chair gets tested before I sit. Trust issues.

quirks.text: always has a pocket full of acorns or conkers
quirks.bio: Pockets usually full of acorns or conkers.

quirks.text: greets the morning with a big stretch out the window
quirks.bio: Mornings start with a big stretch out the window.

quirks.text: keeps meticulous notes on every pie they've eaten
quirks.bio: Meticulous notes on every pie I've eaten. Bring pie.

quirks.text: knows a little poem for any occasion
quirks.bio: Got a little poem for any occasion. Test me.

quirks.text: carries a handkerchief embroidered with someone else's initials
quirks.bio: My handkerchief has someone else's initials. Long story.

quirks.text: pats every bench they pass
quirks.bio: Every bench I pass gets a friendly pat.

quirks.text: writes letters with a fountain pen and seals them with wax
quirks.bio: Letters from me come in fountain pen and sealing wax.

quirks.text: is suspicious of all soup
quirks.bio: Deeply suspicious of all soup.

quirks.text: keeps a pebble in their pocket for luck
quirks.bio: A lucky pebble rides in my pocket.

quirks.text: only drinks from one particular chipped mug
quirks.bio: One chipped mug. Only that one.

quirks.text: stops to read every notice board
quirks.bio: Can't pass a notice board without reading all of it.

quirks.text: carries a small notebook of overheard sayings
quirks.bio: Careful what you say. My notebook of overheard sayings is hungry.

quirks.text: always arrives with something baked
quirks.bio: Never arrive anywhere without something baked.

quirks.text: counts under their breath when nervous
quirks.bio: When nervous, I count under my breath.

quirks.text: keeps a little music box by the window and winds it nightly
quirks.bio: Winding my little music box is how every night ends.

quirks.text: puts a coin in every fountain
quirks.bio: A coin goes into every fountain I pass.

quirks.text: refuses to step on cracks in the pavement
quirks.bio: Watch me avoid every crack in the pavement.

quirks.text: folds every letter into thirds, exactly
quirks.bio: Letters get folded into thirds. Exactly thirds.
